products.name: Marble Shiner
products.description: M555 Shiner is a premium marble enhancer specially formulated to deliver a luxurious gloss and promote a smoother marble surface. For a flawless shine, simply pour the product, scrub evenly, and use a polishing machine to achieve a rich, high-gloss finish that enhances the marble's natural beauty.

specifications.value: Pour product, scrub evenly, and use polishing machine

products.name: Surface Disinfectant & Cleaner
products.description: R33 Disinfectant is a powerful cleaning solution specially formulated to kill 99.9% of germs while effectively removing tough stains and dirt. Its advanced formula leaves behind a pleasant floral fragrance, helping keep surfaces clean, fresh, and hygienic. Use R33 regularly for everyday cleaning and complete germ protection.

products.name: Polyester Stone Adhesive Mastic
products.description: Eliminate joint filling problems on granite or marble floors in commercial buildings with this strong adhesive. It keeps your floor durable and resistant to external changes. With this polyester resin flooring, maintenance becomes hassle-free, thanks to its powerful adhesive properties. Best of all, it is available in both liquid and solid forms, allowing you to use it exactly as needed for your specific application.

products.name: Transparent Gel Adhesive
products.description: Monex Hipo-Glue Gel is a premium natural white, non-yellowing two-component epoxy paste specially designed for bonding, filling cracks, holes, and repairing marble, granite, and stone surfaces. Its strong adhesion and smooth finish make it ideal for repairing both minor and major imperfections while maintaining the natural appearance of the stone.

products.name: Nano Densifier Sil-200
products.description: Helps strengthen and harden stone surfaces for improved durability. Reduces porosity and increases stone density for better protection. Nano particles penetrate and fill micro pores, enhancing surface strength and performance.

products.name: Nano Densifier Sil-800
products.description: Helps eliminate remaining micro pores for a smoother and more refined surface. Further compacts the stone surface to enhance strength and durability. Achieves a higher level of gloss and clarity for an enhanced finish.

products.name: Polygel Mastic Paste
products.description: Monex L-Special is a premium-quality, two-component polyester-based gel adhesive specially developed for bonding, filling, and repairing white, light-colored, and transparent crystalline natural stones such as Carrara, Thassos, and Onyx. Its water-clear, virtually colorless formulation provides a transparent finish that preserves and enhances the natural crystalline appearance of the stone while delivering strong and reliable adhesion.

specifications.value: Carrara, Thassos, Onyx, crystalline natural stones

products.name: Bottom Surface Stone Sealer
products.description: A solvent-based water-repellent sealer specially formulated for marble, granite, limestone, and natural stone. It seals the base surface to help prevent moisture penetration, staining, efflorescence, and weather damage while maintaining the stone's natural appearance.

specifications.value: Moisture penetration, staining, efflorescence, weather damage

products.name: 2-Part Epoxy System (Resin & Hardener)
products.description: A high-performance two-component epoxy coating system designed for marble, granite, and stone surfaces. It provides strong adhesion, excellent crack penetration, and a clear, durable finish. The resin and hardener are mixed in the recommended ratio to deliver reliable bonding and long-lasting protection against moisture and surface wear.

products.name: Stone Darkener Plus Color Enhancer
products.description: Stone Darkner Plus is specially formulated to enhance and restore the natural appearance of granite surfaces by bringing out their true color and richness. It helps revive dull-looking stone, improves visual depth, and provides a more vibrant, refreshed finish while highlighting the stone's original beauty and texture.

products.name: Heavy Duty Stone Stain Remover
products.description: Monex Stain Remover is a water-based formulation specially designed to remove tough stains from marble, tiles, and stone surfaces effectively. It helps restore the original appearance of surfaces while ensuring efficient cleaning performance. Use with caution and follow safety instructions carefully, as improper handling may be hazardous to health.

products.description: Engineered for clean, precision grooving in stone, marble, tiles, and granite. Available in U-Groove, V-Groove, and C-Groove shapes with configurable blade sizes.
